_comment: Copy to .claude/settings.json and replace every /absolute/path/to/your/repo. Permissions are the read-only and routine-write commands an agent runs constantly; a push always asks.

hooks._comment: Refresh the knowledge graph once per session and print its stats, so the agent starts with a current index.
hooks.command: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && { code-review-graph update --repo "/absolute/path/to/your/repo" >/dev/null 2>&1; code-review-graph status --repo "/absolute/path/to/your/repo"; } || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'

hooks._comment: Incremental re-index after every edit; --skip-flows keeps it fast enough to run inline.
A policy reminder costs nothing when it lives in a hook instead of the always-loaded instruction file.
hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Codebase exploration: query the code-review-graph MCP tools BEFORE Grep/Glob/Read - semantic_search_nodes to find code, query_graph for callers/callees/imports_of/tests_for, get_impact_radius for blast radius, detect_changes plus get_review_context for review. Fall back to file scanning only when the graph does not cover what you need. Reading a known specific file path, a non-code file, or command output does not require a graph query first."},"suppressOutput":true}'
